description: DevFlow: the Bash guard, the same pinned command as the Bash hook in .claude/settings.json (make guard-pin rewrites both). Codex runs it once the project is trusted, and skips it after every change until you trust it again in /hooks (.agents/rules/two-tools.md).

hooks.command: for py in python3 python; do "$py" -I -S -c 'import json' </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; py=; done; [ -n "$py" ] || { echo 'BLOCKED: this guard cannot read the tool call -- no working python3 or python on PATH (see INSTALL.md).' >&2; exit 2; }; r="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}"; g="$r/.claude/hooks/bash_guard.py"; [ -f "$g" ] || { echo "BLOCKED: the Bash guard cannot run -- $g is missing (INSTALL-MANIFEST.md). Restore it; the owner re-pins it with make guard-pin (INSTALL.md, Changing the Bash guard)." >&2; exit 2; }; h=$("$py" -I -S -c 'import hashlib,sys;print(hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[1],"rb").read()).hexdigest())' "$g" </dev/null 2>/dev/null); [ "$h" = "c085b476470956f2291b203366eb5345a252b6636e28baff7d11c2d57a38af26" ] || { echo 'BLOCKED: .claude/hooks/bash_guard.py is not the guard the settings pin (sha256 c085b4764709). A session started before the pin changed keeps the old pin: restart Claude Code. Otherwise the owner runs make guard-pin (INSTALL.md, Changing the Bash guard).' >&2; exit 2; }; "$py" -I -S "$g"; rc=$?; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || exit 2
